title: Update MealPlanFiles Helper Signatures and Bracketing
description: Add folderURL parameters to MealPlanFiles.readText and writeText, bracket startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL instead of the file URL, and update meal-plan logs to include folder path and didStart.
acceptance_criteria: MealPlanFiles.readText has signature accepting from url and folderURL.
MealPlanFiles.writeText has signature accepting text, destination url, and folderURL.
Both helpers call startAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL only.
Both helpers stop accessing folderURL only when didStart is true.
Logs use the mealPlans logger and include folder path plus didStart.

handoff_summary.completed: Both MealPlanFiles.readText(from:folderURL:) and MealPlanFiles.writeText(_:to:folderURL:) signatures updated. Security-scoped resource access now bracketed on folderURL instead of the file URL. Log messages extended with folder path and didStart on all exit paths.
handoff_summary.remaining: Caller updates are assigned to separate beads: B-10050947 (AddToMealPlanService), B-be81c856 (MealPlanDetailView), B-d899a92a (AddToMealPlanSheet), B-9ee7182f (CreateShoppingListFromMealPlanService). Test file updates in B-3b650b3d (MealPlanFilesTests).
handoff_summary.risks: All callers of the old signatures will fail to compile until their respective beads run. The build is intentionally broken between this bead and the caller-update beads — this is expected pipeline behaviour.
handoff_summary.next_action: Caller-update beads (B-10050947, B-be81c856, B-d899a92a, B-9ee7182f) and test bead B-3b650b3d should run next to restore compilation and add regression tests.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Any bead that reads or calls MealPlanFiles.readText or MealPlanFiles.writeText will see compilation errors until its own caller-update bead runs. No overlap with ShoppingListFiles beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Followed the identical pattern established by the ShoppingListFiles sibling bead (B-54e5ddb5): folderURL as trailing parameter, bracket on folder not file URL, log folder path and didStart on all exit paths.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: B-3b650b3d is the dedicated bead for updating MealPlanFilesTests to use the new signatures.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: Build is broken until caller beads complete — this is expected and by pipeline design.

conflict_risks: Any bead that reads or calls MealPlanFiles.readText or MealPlanFiles.writeText will see compilation errors until its own caller-update bead runs. No overlap with ShoppingListFiles beads.

execution_history.summary: Updated MealPlanFiles.readText and writeText to accept a folderURL parameter, bracket startAccessingSecurityScopedResource/stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource on folderURL only, and include folder path plus didStart in all log messages. Pattern mirrors the already-completed ShoppingListFiles sibling bead.
